newsitem.title: USA: Real estate firms LaSalle, Galbreath merge.
newsitem.headline: Real estate firms LaSalle, Galbreath merge.

text.p: Real estate services and investment firm LaSalle Partners said it merged with property management, leasing and development management firm The Galbreath Co in a stock transaction of undisclosed size.

The merged company, to be called LaSalle Partners, would have combined office, industrial and retail property managed and leased which totaled more than 200 million square feet, the privately-held company said.
It would manage a total of over 80 million square feet of facility-related projects, LaSalle said.
Galbreath chairman and CEO Lizanne Galbreath would be actively involved in the merged company as a member of the LaSalle Partners Board and a major shareholder of the combined company, Lasalle said.

She would also assume the post of CEO of LaSalle Galbreath Development Inc, which would focus on expanding the combined firm's national development, redevelopment and other actions to take advantage of market opportunities, LaSalle said.

LaSalle Partners said it would maintain corporate offices in 17 cities in the United States as well as London, Mexico City, Paris and Beijing. Key shared markets included Chicago, New York, San Francisco and Washington DC, it said.
